meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Includes 50+ styles, 161 color palettes, 57 font pairings, 161 product types, 99 UX guidelines, and 25 chart types across 10 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and HTML/CSS). Actions: plan, build, create, design, implement, review, fix, improve, optimize, enhance, refactor, and check UI/UX code. Projects: website, landing page, dashboard, admin panel, e-commerce, SaaS, portfolio, blog, and mobile app. Elements: button, modal, navbar, sidebar, card, table, form, and chart. Styles: glassmorphism, claymorphism, minimalism, brutalism, neumorphism, bento grid, dark mode, responsive, skeuomorphism, and flat design. Topics: color systems, accessibility, animation, layout, typography, font pairing, spacing, interaction states, shadow, and gradient. Integrations: shadcn/ui MCP for component search and examples.

copy.tagline: 生成并优化 UI/UX 设计代码与视觉方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成或改进 Web 和移动端的 UI/UX 设计。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and optimize UI/UX design code and visual solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or improve UI/UX designs for web and mobile.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 10 个优先级（从无障碍到图表）检查 UI 设计，并给出改进建议。它还能查询 50+ 风格、161 种配色、57 种字体搭配等数据库。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 设计或修改网页/App 的界面、组件、配色、排版，或者审查 UI 代码时，它会自动启用。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 仪表盘的布局，用玻璃拟态风格。
say.note: Claude 会按优先级规则生成布局建议。

say.text: 检查这个按钮组件的无障碍和触摸目标大小。
say.note: Claude 会检查对比度、焦点状态等。

say.text: 给这个登录页推荐一套配色和字体搭配。
say.note: Claude 会从数据库中匹配推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will check UI designs against 10 priority rules (from accessibility to charts) and provide improvement suggestions. It can also query a database of 50+ styles, 161 color palettes, 57 font pairings, etc.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you ask Claude to design or modify web/app interfaces, components, colors, typography, or review UI code.

say_en.text: Design a SaaS dashboard layout with glassmorphism style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate layout suggestions following priority rules.

say_en.text: Check this button component for accessibility and touch target size.
say_en.note: Claude will check contrast, focus states, etc.

say_en.text: Recommend a color palette and font pairing for this landing page.
say_en.note: Claude will match from its database.
